# Priyanshu Shishodia

> Video editor, designer and full-stack developer: short-form video and
> content, brand websites, and full-stack and AI products, one person from
> start to finish.

Priyanshu Shishodia creates and edits video content and builds websites and
software. The portfolio has three parts: video editing and content creation,
brand websites, and apps and products. Priyanshu is a Software Engineer at
Hypeliv and open to freelance work, collaborations and full-time roles,
on-site or remote.

## Video editing & content creation

- [Video editing](https://shishodious.github.io/video): short-form and social
  edits, content creation, ads and promos, podcasts and talking heads,
  corporate and brand films, documentary and music videos.
- Style: tight cuts, considered colour, and pacing built around the story;
  edits made to hold attention past the first second, including "life
  crossovers" and gym edits.
- Tools: CapCut, DaVinci Resolve, After Effects, Premiere Pro.

## Brand websites

- [Brand websites](https://shishodious.github.io/brand): sites that feel like
  the brand before anyone reads a word, from brief to launch.
- Process: listen, visual direction, design (phone first, real copy), build
  (React and Next.js, GSAP motion, headless CMS), launch with analytics and
  handover.
- SEO and AEO handled end to end: technical and on-page SEO, JSON-LD schema,
  llms.txt, AI crawler access, answer-first copy, and analytics (Search
  Console, GA4, Tag Manager, Meta Pixel, Microsoft Clarity).

## Apps & products

- [Apps & products](https://shishodious.github.io/apps): full-stack web apps,
  AI-integrated products, backend and API systems, realtime apps, and
  automation and scraping, from first commit to production.
- Stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, AWS,
  BullMQ, LLM APIs, Google Gemini, pgvector, TypeScript.
- Notable work: Momentum (AI marketing engine that turns a brief into
  on-brand images, reels and carousels and auto-publishes them) and Creator
  Vision (AI brand detection inside TikTok and YouTube videos), both built at
  Hypeliv.
